items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: I hear a lot of people talking about him, but Al Wynn, is he from New Orleans?

ctx.x: Was he a real tonk trombone player? I was? Tonk trombone player, could he play dirty? I didn't, I didn't know him to play like dirty. I know he played the music and stuff. Yeah. He could really beat a bass. He did.

Mm-hmm. One fellow I wanna ask you, maybe you don't know, but the seems that I never asked him, it seems like he's from here, but I hear a lot of people talking about him, but Al Wynn, is he from New Orleans? Yeah?

Yeah, but I don't think he played down here. We were talking about that, Willie Humphrey was saying how many guys were from here like Simeon and Al Wynn and they didn't play anything down here. Uh-huh. Preston Jackson, you know.
